features.what: Toggle between photo and video mode; shutter starts/stops recording

features.name: Take photo while recording

features.name: Exposure lock
features.what: Lock/unlock auto exposure

features.name: Settings icon
features.what: Open the Settings screen

features.name: Gallery thumbnail

features.name: Cycle flash icon
features.what: Optional icon cycling flash modes directly

features.name: Face detection icon

features.what: Optional icon toggling auto-level
